evidence.decision: Chooses visual grid/row versus text list, reserves focus expansion and prevents unrequested reordering during iOS/iPad manipulation.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a cell/layout/interaction artifact and an explicit layout-change policy preserving item identity.
evidence.transformation: Wallpaper grid freezes popularity-driven reshuffling during dragging and exposes deliberate refresh/sort while preserving selection.
evidence.verification: Exercises odd counts, long labels, edge focus, reorder and selected-item deletion; checks collisions, scroll activation and identity loss.
evidence.applicability: Custom gestures need a task reason, Watch receives a suitable list adaptation and native input execution is not inferred from logic.
evidence.handoffs: Hands text comparison to Lists, fitting to Image views and actual transfer to Drag and drop.
evidence.distinctiveness: Visual-recognition layout plus stable item identity during manipulation creates collection-specific operational decisions.
